Original upstream URLs, exact hashes and every extracted licence file are in runtime-source-manifest.json. The locally assembled source archives are unmodified snapshots. The manifest and checksums describe that historical assembly; they do not mean those archives are present in this checkout. Electron patch stacks are retained in its full archive, not silently applied to other snapshots.

See SOURCE_ACCESS.md for source coverage, publication status and the separate combined-runtime relink limitation. These materials are not claimed to be a self-contained complete Chromium build checkout.

Some Chromium text URLs return base64 transport data (`format=TEXT`). The manifest records `base64: true` for those entries; its byte counts and hashes apply after decoding.
